announcement.title: $display_version
announcement.content: Movement routing now re-evaluates strategic destination changes across all shared consumers, Bypass TP selects destination-island spawns instead of arbitrary nearby islands, multi-target combat shares the farm target set, and Berry ESP/collection use one event-driven cache.

changelog.title: $display_version
changelog.content: End-to-End shared-engine update: separates TargetRevision from RouteRevision so Auto Farm Level, Material, Mastery, Island, Berry and legacy _tp consumers re-enter Portal/Bypass/Tween planning when their strategic destination changes without re-routing on every moving combat target. Bypass TP remains Portal-exclusive and now selects only spawn points mapped to the actual destination island when such mapping is available. Fast Attack consumes the same allowed target set retained by CombatTargetLock/BringMob so valid grouped targets are not internally narrowed to the primary mob name. Berry discovery, ESP and Auto Collect share one tag/event index with late-prompt discovery and collection confirmation. Fishing quest behavior is synchronized only from the supplied main.lua contract (Fishing Lv.20+, Angler AskQuest, UI confirmation, FinishQuest). Tween correction now requires a persistent correction condition to avoid one-frame cancel/recreate pauses.

changelog.title: Re4Hub v2.0.8
changelog.content: Shared-runtime stability update: fixed stale follower ownership after arrival, refreshed route context across farm phases, rebased bounded server correction from the actual player position, added Bypass TP transport support, event-driven Berry collection, fail-closed ability ownership, capability-driven Mastery skill selection and shared Auto Farm Island.

changelog.title: Re4Hub v2.0.7
changelog.content: Added SkyLower/SkyUpper transition awareness, bounded external-relocation replan and route-hazard handling so map-trigger teleports do not leave stale tween state.
